## D — Accuracy and verification

Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical page eighty-six, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: ages, holding periods, passenger counts, curfew hours, extension and suspension lengths, and the act number and amendment date are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: none open; the single summary page extracted as readable text, and its handheld-device restriction prints without the words may not, so it is stated as a ban because it sits in the restriction list; the page labels its passenger and handheld rules as new for its amendment year and those labels were kept as history, not as current dates.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.

corpus_stability.reason: The Alabama Driver Manual is one dated edition (front cover, physical p1, prints November 2024); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
